# Draft:Jambo Stakeholder Relationship Management software

Jambo (also known as Jambo SRM) is a cloud-based stakeholder relationship management (SRM) software platform developed in Edmonton, Alberta, Canada. The software is used by organizations to document, manage, and report on stakeholder engagement activities, including communications, issues, and commitments, to create auditable consultation histories.
History
Jambo was launched in [https://albertainnovates.ca/news/learn-how-alberta-is-innovating-in-energy-resources-2/ 2016] by [https://watersmartsolutions.ca/tom-grabowski/ Tom Grabowski] and Bob Morton in Edmonton, Alberta. The company is part of the [https://www.ccib.ca/main/member/silvacom/ Silvacom Group of Companies]. The name Jambo is derived from a Swahili greeting similar to the English word "hello."
Software overview
Jambo is categorized as stakeholder management software, a type of system used to centralize information related to stakeholder interactions and management. SRM platforms, including Jambo, are generally described as offering tools and features for managing stakeholder profiles, tracking communications, logging issues and commitments, generating reports, and supporting mapping and spatial understanding relevant to stakeholder engagement activities.
The software is listed in the Esri ArcGIS Marketplace, indicating its compatibility with geospatial workflows and data.
Target industries
Stakeholder management technology has become increasingly utilized in sectors that require structured consultation processes and the ability to demonstrate a history of engagement with stakeholders and communities, such as infrastructure development, [https://northamericanmining.com/index.php/2025/06/30/how-teams-in-mining-resolve-stakeholder-engagement-challenges/ resource management], energy and renewable energy, and public sector projects. Industry publications discuss the role of stakeholder management platforms in supporting communication, [https://bmmagazine.co.uk/business/a-collaborative-connection-how-stakeholder-engagement-supports-your-esg-strategy/ ESG reporting], and operational planning. The broader stakeholder management software market has been projected to reach USD 6.7 billion by 2033.
Philanthropy
In 2019, Jambo joined the [https://www.pledge1percent.org/jambo-joins-global-leaders-in-the-pledge-1-movement-to-support-classroom-development-in-sub-saharan-africa/ Pledge 1%] initiative, committing 1% of the company's profits to charitable causes. The company designated its contribution to Classrooms for Africa, a Canadian charity that supports community-led school construction in disadvantaged parts of Sub-Saharan Africa. Employees visits these parts of Africa to ensure that the constructions are progressing or completed.
